name: bar-book
description: Black Tap Bar Book: phone web app for the Black Tap Soho bar, floor and kitchen team

scripts.build: cd src && node build.js && node site.js ..
scripts.build:emu: cd src && node build.js && node site.js ../.emusite --emu
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:emu && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-bar-book "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/e2e/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
